headline: Central Fronts Erupt in Callahan's Passage and Dead Lands
war_summary: Intense clashes have abruptly erupted across the central front, where Callahan's Passage and the previously subdued Dead Lands recorded severe casualty spikes exceeding a thousand casualties apiece over the past two hours. Along the Nevish Line, fluid fighting persists unabated, logging five strategic base shifts and over twelve hundred bilateral losses in the latest two-hour window. By contrast, the brutal meatgrinder in Linn of Mercy has noticeably cooled, yielding just a single base event as casualty rates fell steeply. Tactical volatility continues in Marban Hollow and Weathered Expanse, each generating four base exchanges across contested outposts despite moderate casualty numbers. Minor territorial disruptions also touched Farranac Coast and Stonecradle with localized structure losses, while Stlican Shelf sustains heavy firefights with nearly eight hundred casualties over two hours without immediate border revision. Rearward logistics zones and maritime reaches remain undisturbed by enemy action.
